_comment: Display-only catalog of Helldivers 2 data archives. Maps an archive hash to a friendly name and a kind (graphics | sound | other) used for labelling and grouping on the Patch Conflicts page. This file is NOT the authority on which archives exist - that comes from scanning the game's own data folder - so an entry missing here is cosmetic only and an entry present here for an archive the install does not have is harmless. Keys that are not a 16-character hex hash are ignored, so comments like this one are safe to keep.
